entries.text: 走啊走，走啊走……！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_01

entries.text: 我说，没问题吗？\n那个……那孩子……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_01

entries.text: 你说乌栗？那家伙呀～\n暂时不会来社团活动室了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_02

entries.text: 我来介绍一下，\n这里就是联盟社的活动室！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_03

entries.text: 我代表联盟社\n欢迎你～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_24

entries.text: 联盟社是什么？
entries.label: sdc02_0089_select_01

entries.text: 是怎样的社团？
entries.label: sdc02_0089_select_02

entries.text: 嘿嘿，\n问得好！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_04

entries.text: 在蓝莓学园呀～\n有个叫做[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]蓝莓联盟[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]的制度，\r\n用来对学生的宝可梦实力进行排名。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_05

entries.text: 为了争夺高排名，\n社员会一起锻炼宝可梦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_06

entries.text: 有输也有赢，\n一起尽情闹翻天～\r\n这就是联盟社！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_07

entries.text: 差不多是这样，但你的说法……[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_03

entries.text: ……嗯！现在的风头\n的确有点变了～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_08

entries.text: 我也是社员，\n虽然不怎么来社团活动室。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_04

entries.text: 顺带一提，在蓝莓联盟，\n实力达到顶级水平的４个人\r\n被称为[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]蓝莓联盟四天王[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_05

entries.text: 这个让人不爽的\n头发飘飘男……\r\n还有刚才在巨蛋见到的孩子也是四天王。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_06

entries.text: 丹瑜你没进排名哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_09

entries.text: 我只是校外活动太忙，\n没空参加联盟战而已～[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_07

entries.text: 以我的实力，\n四天王什么的根本不在话下。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_08

entries.text: 嘿嘿嘿，说的没错～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_10

entries.text: 怎么样，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n我们社团感觉很欢乐吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_11

entries.text: 给你留下好印象了！\n要的就是这个。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_12

entries.text: 你虽然嘴上这么说，\n内心其实……对吧？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_13

entries.text: 好嘞～！\n临时入社搞定！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_14

entries.text: 啊？临时入社是什么啊？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_09

entries.text: 嗯！阿若我觉得啊～\n我们已经是临时伙伴了！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_15

entries.text: 你可以自由进出社团活动室，\n放在这里的东西也可以随便用～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_16

entries.text: 那台电脑也是个\n很方便的东西哦。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_17

entries.text: 用收集到的ＢＰ进行赞助，\n其他社团的家伙们就会\r\n在各方各面帮助你。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_18

entries.text: ……死学不如实践，\n你来试试看吧。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_25

entries.text: 用这东西，就能从棒球社的\n投秀那里学习投球方式。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_26

entries.text: 你上哪儿去？\n试试用电脑发送ＢＰ吧。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_stopper

entries.text: 死学不如实践，\c\n试试用电脑\n赞助ＢＰ吧。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_npc

entries.text: 他开～始搞事情了呢。\n虽然很麻烦，但你顺着他来吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_npc

entries.text: 哦？这不是成功了吗？[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_27

entries.text: 你才第一次尝试，就这么厉害～\n哎呀～我小看你了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_28

entries.text: 对稳定发挥的你，\n这东西我让利大酬宾！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_30

entries.text: 这个也顺便送你，\n搭配好的话，能和我穿成一对儿。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_31

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从杜若那里\n获得了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]联盟社的衣服[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: sdc02_0089_system_02

entries.text: 刚才我也说过，\n你已经是临时伙伴了！\r\n电脑可以随便用～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_29

entries.text: 而且仅限现在！！\n放在这里的零食也随你吃！！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_19

entries.text: 你说的零食……\n是你吃剩下的吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_10

entries.text: 不知道那是什么时候的东西，\n我建议你别碰为妙。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_11

entries.text: 介绍了这么多，\n肚子都饿了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_20

entries.text: 我要去一下食堂。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_21

entries.text: 等你打定主意想正式加入社团，\n我们就在食堂边约会边说吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_dragonbb_22

entries.text: 哎～！那家伙！\n真不知道他在搞什么！！[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_13

entries.text: 而且还说什么约会……\n啊？约会是什么意思啊！？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_14

entries.text: 冷静点
entries.label: sdc02_0089_select_03

entries.text: 约会这个词的意思是……
entries.label: sdc02_0089_select_04

entries.text: 提前跟你说清楚，\n我可不是在对约会这事激动。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_15

entries.text: 等等，字面意思我当然知道了！\n你这人……没想到还挺早熟的！？[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_16

entries.text: ……抱歉，在这里\n果然还是觉得不自在。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_17

entries.text: 我们换个地方吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_18

entries.text: 没人打扰的地方……\n就去你房间吧。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_19

entries.text: 你不知道房间在哪儿？\n凭感觉走走就知道了。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0089_sister_20
